page_title: MET 0-0 HAV | Metz v Le Havre 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Loic Nego (Le Havre) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Metz.
90+4' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

90+4' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Corner kick. Metz will have an opportunity.
90+2' Ibou Sane (Metz) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Guillaume Paradis saw the whole situation.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
89' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Metz have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' It's like he was asking for a caution. Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) receives a yellow card.
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jessy Deminguet will be replaced by Alpha Toure (Metz).
86' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre) replaces Abdoulaye Toure.
86' Reda Khadra goes off the pitch and Younes Namli (Le Havre) comes on.
85' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 13:15.
83' Loic Nego (Le Havre) is penalised for a foul. Guillaume Paradis had a clear view and blows his whistle.
81' The ball rebounds to Thomas Delaine (Le Havre) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift high over the bar.
81' Substitution. Morgan Bokele Mputu makes way for Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz).
81' Stephane Le Mignan prepares a substitution. Gauthier Hein is replaced by Ibou Sane (Metz).
78' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
76' Here comes a substitution. Thomas Delaine (Le Havre) is brought on as a substitute for Yanis Zouaoui.
75' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
74' Boubacar Traore (Metz) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
73' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the left post.
73' Gauthier Hein (Metz) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
72' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Le Havre due to a foul in the build-up play.
71' The Le Havre players joy may have been justified, because referee Guillaume Paradis is going use VAR to determine the legality of a challenge.
70' The Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Guillaume Paradis rules it out for a foul.
69' 3:9 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 0:2.
66' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but Mory Diaw comes off his line to gather the ball.
65' Reda Khadra (Le Havre) unloads a good strike from the free kick just outside the box. His effort towards the left post is stopped by Jonathan Fischer, who pulls off a glorious save!
64' Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) trips an opposition player and Guillaume Paradis signals a foul. Le Havre have a free kick from a promising distance.
63' Boubacar Traore (Metz) is teed up by Georgiy Tsitaishvili, but his shot from distance is yards wide of the left post.
62' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) serves up a nice cross, but Mory Diaw punches the ball away.
61' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) is being substituted because of an injury. Didier Digard sends Fode Doucoure on the pitch.
61' It's time for a substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) comes on in place of Simon Ebonog.
60' Gauthier Hein (Metz) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
60' A cross from Gauthier Hein (Metz) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. Metz win a corner kick.
58' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

56' Jonathan Fischer makes a brilliant save! Reda Khadra (Le Havre) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the left side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
55' Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
54' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jonathan Fischer, who smothers the ball.
52' Reda Khadra (Le Havre) produces a long-range strike, but he only hits one of his own teammates standing in its way.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jessy Deminguet (Metz) was quite harsh and Guillaume Paradis didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Loic Nego (Le Havre) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
48' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) sends the corner into the box, but Jonathan Fischer intercepts it and averts the threat.

47' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee blows his whistle, Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.
46' Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle for a foul after Gauthier Hein (Metz) hacks down one of his opponents. Le Havre will take a free kick near the side line.
46' Stephane Le Mignan makes a half-time substitution. Georgiy Tsitaishvili comes on in place of Urie-Michel Mboula (Metz).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) sends it out of play.

45+3' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Le Havre force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+2' Reda Khadra (Le Havre) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+2' Reda Khadra (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Metz keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
43' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Habib Diallo, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
41' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) touches the ball with his hand.
41' Gauthier Hein (Metz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
39' Boubacar Traore (Metz) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.

37' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
35' Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Le Havre.
35' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is able to continue to play.
34' The total number of attempts is 2:2. 0:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
34' The game is interrupted now, Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Gauthier Hein (Metz) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
30' The referee is firm and issues Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) a deserved yellow card.
28' Boubacar Traore (Metz) loses his marker and gets on the end of the free kick, but he is unable to control the ball properly and balloons his close-range header high over the bar.
27' Guillaume Paradis interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre). Metz win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
26' The corner by Reda Khadra (Le Havre) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
25' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Le Havre.
25' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
20' Surely that's handball by one of the Metz players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
20' Loic Nego (Le Havre) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
20' Reda Khadra (Le Havre) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
20' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Le Havre manage to earn a corner.
18' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
16' The ball possession is 58:42.
15' Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
13' A dangerous looking corner kick from Reda Khadra (Le Havre) is cleared to safety by the defence.
13' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) whips in a cross from the corner, but Jonathan Fischer is well positioned and punches the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Le Havre will have a corner.
9' Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
7' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Guillaume Paradis blows for a foul.
6' Half-chance! Issa Soumare (Le Havre) plays a pass into the box, but Jonathan Fischer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
5' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
1' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Metz will have the kick-off.
Guillaume Paradis is introduced as the referee for today's match.
